description:
Duty on a year of the caller's goods at their stated rate, and what a
preference claim under the UK-India trade agreement could be worth.

COMPUTED from `profile` alone (spend, duty rate, preference status), with no
network call. Whether goods qualify depends on their code and the rules of
origin; the response names where to check.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: duty_at_stake
title: Duty at stake
